description: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. states its goal is to continue to achieve growth in sales and profitability by capitalizing on its competitive advantages and executing its growth strategies, remaining confident in its ability to continue to gain market share in its existing markets and grow its business in new markets by focusing on its dual market strategy and core values including hard work, superior customer service and expense control, with a mission to be the dominant auto parts provider in all the markets it serves by providing a higher level of customer service and a better value position than its competitors to both DIY and professional service provider customers. It believes its effective dual market strategy, superior customer service, technically proficient store personnel, strategic distribution network and experienced management team make up its key competitive advantages, which cannot be easily duplicated, and for more than 45 years it has established a track record of effectively serving, at a high level, both DIY and professional service provider customers.
